name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.2 degrees south of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 6 visits over 49 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.0 days starting 2025-10-20, at wavelengths from 1.18 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
